render_string_or_bytes: render a string or bytes literal with multiline support and abbreviation for long strings
render_dict: render a dictionary with inline or multiline formatting based on key complexity
render_sequence_or_set: render a sequence or set including tuples, lists, sets, and namedtuples as foldable trees
render_namedtuple_or_ast: render a namedtuple or AST node with keyword-style field arguments
handle_basic_types: handle rendering of basic builtin Python types including dataclasses with optional background colors
